text:
Asha Iyer: Quick heads-up — our vendor for the acoustic panel demo is dropping off a small crate at ~2:40pm. It's fragile and the courier will need a sign-off. Can someone free up a bench in the lounge? :speaker:
Tom Briggs: I can clear Bench B (by the plants). Will move my laptop bag into Locker 2. Do we need to prepare a visitor badge or just a one-time sticker?
Asha Iyer: Prefer a temporary sticker badge, they won't be on site longmaybe 20-30 mins. Also they'll need Visitor Lot A pass; license plate is TBD.
FrontDeskBot: Delivery ticket created (ID 6821). ETA 14:43. Assigned bench: Lounge-B. Temporary sticker badge ready at front desk. Package stored in short-term locker L2 until sign-off. Note: courier must show ID. :package:
Priya Rao: I'll print the Visitor Lot A pass now and leave it with the sticker badge in an envelope labeled "Asha - Acoustic Demo." Laminating machine by the kitchenette is free if you want it sturdier.
Drew Lin: I'll meet them at the loading dock at 14:35 and walk the crate in. Anyone want me to grab some cardboard for ramping? That crate is light but tall.
Tom Briggs: Thanks Drew. I'll tape down the loose corner of the bench cushion so it doesn't snag during carry-in. Also putting a small "reserved" post-it on Bench B in case someone sits. :memo:
Asha Iyer: Amazing. Please tell them they don't need to go past the lounge. Sticker badge is fine. I'll collect the envelope after sign-off.
FrontDeskBot: Reminder scheduled at 14:40 to Front Desk staff to expect courier. Locker L2 code: `2139`. Delivery ticket 6821 will be auto-closed after sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: Envelope printed and on front desk. If anyone wants the pass laminated, say so before 14:25.
Drew Lin: On route to loading dock. Will ping when crate is coming in.
Tom Briggs: Bench cleared and bag moved. See you all in a bit. :wave:
Asha Iyer: Thank you team! Also, FYI, acoustic panels smell faintly of pine when new  office smell update for the day. :pine_tree:
